Commentary.Commentary: So 130 is what Pakistan need to clean sweep the T20I series. Elton Chigumbura might not get the farewell he would have been hoping for unless Zimbabwe can pull a rabbit out of the hat with the ball. Can the tourists do something magical and send shockwaves across the cricketing world? Join us for the chase to find out.

Another day, another dominant bowling performance from Pakistan. The gulf in class between the home side's bowling and the tourists batting was once again clearly evident. Usman Qadir continued to tangle Zimbabwe in his spinning web. He was the standout finishing with 4/13. Imad Wasim got two wickets. Rauf was expensive but still impressive. Hasnain also was in the wickets column, Musa went wicketless but was extremely economical.

After opting to bat, there was hardly anything of substance from the tourists. Another sorry batting performance from the tourists, a running story of the series. Only skipper, Chamu Chibhabha had some valuable contribution as no one else from the top order turned up. A little fight from Tiripano and Masakadza towards the end saved some blushes for the away side. When a side struggles to bat full quota of 20 overs that in itself sums up the batting woes.

Terrific bowling display from Pakistan and it has once again been a one-way traffic. Pakistan superb with the ball, Zimbabwe abysmal with the bat. At the halfway stage, the home side look well on course to inflict another whitewash on Zimbabwe in the shortest format.
Yorker, around off, Blessing goes after it fiercely but misses. The ball too did not miss the off pole by much. Haris is a touch frustrated there. Who will not be! THE VISITORS FINISH AT 129/9.
SWING AND A MISS! On a full length around off, Muzarabani makes room and looks to have a poke at this but misses it altogether.

Back of a length slower ball on the pads, Faraz looks to flick but adjusts and chips it wide of the keeper, towards square leg. Takes a single. Hang on.... the umpire calls it a leg bye. So, it came off the pads.
Shortish ball down the leg side, Faraz moves to the leg side and swings at it but misses completely.
Full on off, driven down to long on for one.
Full on off, driven to cover for a single.
On off, blocked back on the track.

FOUR! Good yorker but quite lucky for Blessing there. Yorker outside off, Muzarabani brings his bat down in time, digs it out off the inner half of his bat. The ball goes safely past the stumps and into the fine leg boundary.
Full on off, blocked to cover.
Blessing Muzarabani is the last man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! This time there is a run out. Around off, the yorker, Donald looks to hit that on the off side but gets it off the inside edge. It goes to backward square leg and the batters run for a single. The throw comes to the striker's end on the second run, Rizwan collects and whips the bails off. Aleem Dar needs no third umpire there, signals out straightaway.

Run out opportunity.... missed! He would have gone straightaway. Around off, this is pushed to cover-point. The batsmen take off for a single. The throw comes to the bowler's end but the bowler is well away from the stumps. The direct hit misses. Had the bowler been closer to the stumps, it could have been effected properly. A single.
Who will join Tiripano out in the middle? The debutant, Faraz Akram strides out for Zimbabwe.

OUT! TAKEN! Outside half off the bat and another wicket for Pakistan. Imad Wasim shows a thumbs up to the bowler. Full and just outside off, Wellingon looks to flick it across the line but gets a thick outside edge. It flies rapidly towards third man where Wasim squats and takes a good catch.
On middle, flicked to square leg for a couple.

FOUR! The fielding standards of Pakistan need to improve. Outside off, Tiripano steers this to the left of third man. The fielder gets there, dives but puts in a poor effort. The ball trickles through and touches the ropes.

Overthrows, confusion but a couple. Around off, dabbed to point. Donald is not quick but the throw, which comes to the bowler's end, misses the stumps. It goes through and another single is sneaked in. 2 runs in total.
Fullish on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
WIDE! Haris overcooks the short ball, the batter lets it be.
Shortish and outside off, punched to the left of mid off for a quick one.
Around off, the batsman looks to play at it but misses it.
Haris Rauf is back into the attack. 2-0-26-1 are his figures so far.
Misfield and a couple. Outside off, run down to third man who misfields and Zimbabwe rush back in for the second.
Outside off, steered wide of backward point for one.
FOUR! Turned to the leg side and turned for a boundary. Full on middle, Masakadza waits and flicks it late. Flicks it well wide of the man at deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely hit. Wellington brings up the 100 for his side as well. Bit short of length, Masakadza drills this over the head of mid off for a boundary. What a shot to bring up the 100.
Back of a length around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short ball, Donald dabs it to point. Masakadza wants a single and Tiripano hurriedly responds, gets to the other end.
Usman Qadir is done for the evening. Who will Babar Azam hand the ball to now? It will be Mohammed Hasnain. 2-0-4-0 so far.
Shortish on middle and leg, tucked away in front of square on the leg side for one.
Short ball on top of the stumps, Wellington blocks it to the off side for a quick single.
Outside off, punched to the right of point for one.
Short ball, the batsman sits under it.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Short and wide outside off, Tiripano proficiently guides this to the third man fence.
FOUR! Not quite where Donald intended, but a boundary nonetheless. Short ball, he pulls at it. Mistimes it but ends up getting it to the mid-wicket boundary still.
Who's in next? Wellington Masakadza walks out with his willow.

OUT! CAUGHT! A sad end for Elton Chigumbura! His last dance comes to an end and he would have wanted to make an impact in his final game! He gets a standing ovation from the Zimbabwe dugout and well deserved! Qadir gets his fourth wicket of the game and what brilliant bowling this has been by him! Floated around middle and leg, Elton Chigumbura gets down on his knees and looks to sweep this one but he nicks this one and Rizwan is as safe as house.
Loopy around off, Tiripano looks to work this to the off side but it comes off his inside edge and goes to the short fine leg region. A single.
FIVE WIDES! Zimbabwe will not mind this at all! Flatter around middle and leg, Tiripano looks to flick this but misses and so does the keeper, the ball runs away to the fine leg fence.
Tossed up around off, Tiripano pushes this back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery around off, Donald lunges forward looking to block, but the ball spins away and just whizzes past his outside edge.
Loopy on off, Elton lofts this over mid off for a single.
Wonderful bowling! Floated on off, Elton goes on his knees and looks to sweep this one but it spins away and he does not connect bat with ball.
SLASH AND A MISS! Back of a length on off, Tiripano looks to cut this one but misses.

Overthrows and another run for Zimbabwe! Poor from Pakistan, not required right now. Back of a length ball outside off, Donald pushes this towards point and they run for the single. There is a throw at the keeper's end but there is no one to back it up and the batters collect another run.
Outside off, punched to the cover region for a dot.
A misfield and a couple! Back of a length ball outside off, Tiripano punches this to the cover region and the fielder there fumbles and the batters pounce on this and collect two runs.
Outside off, punched to covers.

NOT OUT! Rizwan was convinced that this was out but luckily for Zimbabwe, this will remain not out. Back of a length ball outside off, Tiripano looks to cut this one but misses and it goes behind, to Rizwan who catches this and appeals very loudly. The umpire says no. Rizwan convinces Babar Azam to go for the review and the skipper obliges. Ultra Edge comes in and there is no spike as the ball passes the bat. Not out, it will be. Pakistan lose their review, the second one is down the drain.
Review time, again! Pakistan opt for a review for a caught behind. Flat line as the ball passes the bat, as per Ultra Edge. The on field decision stays.
Muhammad Musa is back. 2-0-8-0.
Full toss outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Donald Tiripano is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Usman has spun a web around the Zim batters. They are now 75/6. Qadir lands a nice legbreak full around off, Wesley prods forward to block but gets a thick outside edge. Babar Azam had brought himself in at first slip earlier. Takes the catch quite comfortably.
On middle, swept to fine leg for a single.
A very feeble appeal for LBW. Flatter on off and middle, the legbreak, Elton gets down and looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but to no avail.
Tossed up around off, the batsman prods forward to block but misses. What a wonderful ball that was from Usman.
Who will walk out to the middle now? It is Elton Chigumbura, who is playing his final game for Zimbabwe. He will be looking to make an impact in his final game.

OUT! STUMPED! What a beautiful delivery. He has outfoxed Shumba. Floats the googly around middle, it pitches and goes away. Milton comes down the track and looks to play at it but is flummoxed on that being a googly. He tries to hurriedly tuck it on the off side but misses. Mohammad Rizwan collects the ball and does the rest, whipping the bails off in a flash.
On off, pushed through mid on for one.
SIX! Wow! What a hit! On middle, Shumba slog sweeps this one over the fine leg region for a biggie.
Full on off, Shumba pushes this to mid off.
EDGY! Floated on off, Shumba wanted to heave this one to the off side but he does not connect it well and goes off his outside edge and goes towards short third man, who makes a great stop.
Flatter on middle and leg, Madhevere flicks this to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short, around off, pushed towards point for a single.

NOT OUT! What a close call this was and Madhevere survives! Pakistan opted for a review and they have lost the same! Floated on off, Madhevere looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. They appeal and the umpire says no. Pakistan opt for the review. Ultra Edge shows nothing. Ball Tracker comes in and the impact is outside, so this one will remain not out.

Review time! Pakistan have opted for the DRS to have a look at the LBW decision which went against them, on field. Ultra Edge is in... no bat involved. Ball Tracker is in, impact is outside off. Review gone as far as Pakistan are concerned.
Flatter on middle and leg, Wesley looks to flick but misses it.

FOUR BYES! No one read that ball, not the batter or the keeper! Wonderfully bowled! Floated around off, Wesley looks to push at this but misses and so does the keeper and it runs away to the fine leg fence.
Flighted on off, pushed towards point to rotate the strike.
Loopy delivery on middle, Wesley sweeps this one to deep mid-wicket and will collect a single.
Loopy on middle, pushed to the long off region for a single.
Shortish ball on off, swung away to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off, pushed to mid-wicket.
Floated around off, driven to point.
Flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Who will walk out now? Milton Shumba, it is. Can he stage a revival along with Madhevere?

OUT! TAKEN! Soft dismissal. Ryan arrived in the crease just early, pays the price for going for a glory shot of sorts. Flighted on middle and leg, Burl gets down and looks to reverse sweep at it. But he does not read the ball well. It takes the shoulder of his bat and lobs towards point. Fakhar Zaman there, takes it easily.
Floated on off, pushed to short mid-wicket where Imad runs in and collects.
EDGY! Flatter around off, Wesley looks to push this to the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
BEATEN! What a beuatiful delivery! Floated around off, Wesley lunges forward and looks to defend but it spins away and he gets beaten.
Tosses it up nicely around off, Burl eases this towards long off for a single.
LEG BYE! Flatter around middle and leg, Wesley looks to tuck this to the leg side but misses and it comes off his pads to the leg side. A leg bye collected.
Ryan Burl comes to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper departs and Qadir gets his wicket. He was brilliant in the previous game and continues his good form into this game. Short ball on middle, Chibhabha swivels and looks to slam this over deep square leg but he does not time this one well. He holes out to Haider Ali in the deep, who is not going to drop these chances.

A loud appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire! What a way to start by Usman! A googly on middle, Chibhabha looks to block it out but misses. There is a loud appeal but the umpire says no. Perhaps, going down leg.
Usman Qadir, the Imran Tahir bowl-alike, to bowl now.
Flatter around off, Chamu punches this towards deep point to retain the strike for the next over.

FOUR! IN THE AIR...SAFE! This was a tough chance to scalp but the fielder in the deep is not able to! Floated on off, Chibhabha lofts this towards the long on region, the fielder does well to run in but is not able to catch this. It evades him and goes past the ropes.
Flighted on off, pushed to covers.
SIX! Nicely hit by the skipper! Gives it some air and lands it around off, Chibhabha gets on his knees and mows his slog over the long on fence.
Loopy on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for another single.
Flatter outside off, punched to the deep cover region for one.
Imad Wasim is back to bowl. Bowled an over in the Powerplay earlier.
Full and around off, driven to cover.

Shouts of catch but it lands well ahead of wide long on. Full on middle, Chamu Chibhabha lifts it high in the air over mid on. Pakistani fielders seem excited but it lands well ahead of the man at wide long on. A single for Zimbabwe.
On a length on the stumps, blocked back to the bowler.
Bouncer, Chibhabha telegraphing his intentions to come down early, but has no option to let it through. Good bowling this.
Full on middle, tapped to the off side off the outer half. Another quick run. The throw comes to the bowler's end but misses the stumps.
Outside off, punched to backward point. Chibhabha wants a single and runs to the other end. He realizes late that the throw comes to the bowler's end and then hurries. Makes it in though.
Fullish and nipping back in towards middle, tucked to square leg for a single. Powerplay done and the visitors are 39/2. Need to get a move on here, whilst also guarding their wickets.
Full on middle, closes the face of his bat to glance it to square leg. This time, just the one.
FOUR! Starts off with a boundary, Wesley. Full on middle and leg, Madhevere flicks it well through mid-wicket. Deep mid-wicket gave chase but the ball beats him to the boundary.
Who will join the skipper, Chibhabha out in the middle? It will be the youngster, Wesley Madhevere.

OUT! CAUGHT! Haris Rauf gets a wicket. This is a good catch. Full on middle and leg, Craig looks to wrist that on the leg side. Ends up getting an uppish leading edge. It looked to be falling short of Fakhar at point but he does well to put in a superb dive to hold onto that.
Full around off, driven to mid off for a quick single.
Short and quick on top of the stumps, Chamu comes down the track and looked to loft it over mid on. Ends up missing it. This is the last over of the Powerplay and hence understandable.
Haris Rauf is back on. His first over was expensive, went for 19 runs.
FOUR! That will race away for a boundary. Short ball, Ervine pulls it through the carpet, through mid-wicket. The ball is well wide of the deep square leg fielder and it races away for a boundary.
Full and around off, blocked to cover.
On a length around off, Craig Ervine comes on the front foot and drives it to cover-point.
Slash and a miss! Past the bat there. Fullish and outside off, Ervine goes after it but misses.
Good length ball on top of leg, Craig closes the face of his bat to flick it to short mid-wicket.
Full and on the stumps, driven to the left of mid on for a single. Not much of a timing on that.
Muhammad Musa is handed the ball now for Pakistan.
On middle, glanced to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Who walks out at Number 3 for Zimbabwe? Craig Ervine, it is.

OUT! TAKEN! On second attempt. Khushdil Shah is the man who takes the catch. Flighted on off and middle, Brendan Taylor comes down and flicks it uppishly. It was to the left of Shah at deep square leg. Khushdil runs in that direction and takes it well, on the second attempt after it popped out during his first try.
On middle, flicked to the on side for one.
Tossed up on off, worked to mid on for a single.
Tossed up on off, driven to mid off for a quick single. A shy at the bowler's end but it misses the stumps. Living dangerously here, Chibhabha.
Floated on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
It is time for some spin! Imad Wasim is introduced into the attack.
Full and around off, driven to cover. Nice early call for a no to a single this time.
Full and around off, driven to cover.
Outside off, pushed wide of backward point for a run.
Length and around off, Chamu looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On middle, Taylor looks to glance but gets an inside edge onto his pad and the ball rolls to the off side. Chibhabha wants one and this time, Taylor responds. They hurriedly take one.
Full and around off, blocked to the leg side. Chibhabha wants one and comes down but Taylor sends him back rightfully.
On the pads again, flicked to short mid-wicket. A dot this time but a fruitful over for Zim. 19 runs off it.
On the pads, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! What a shot that is! Full on middle, flicked handsomely through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish on off, dabbed hurriedly to the off side for a quick single.
5 WIDES! Slips one well down the leg side, the keeper dives to his left but it was asking too much. Goes past the keeper's dive and into the fine leg boundary.
FOUR! Cut and four. Glorious! Rauf pitches it slightly short and outside off, Chamu cuts it, well wide of backward point. Another boundary.
FOUR! Driven beautifully. Full and around off, Chibhabha drives it well wide of mid off. Races away for a boundary.
Who will partner Hasnain with the new ball? It will be Haris Rauf.
Outside off, a back-foot drive but straight to cover. 2/0 are Zimbabwe at the end of the first over.
Outside off, punched to point for one. Chamu is finally off the mark.
Full and on off, tapped to the leg side. Chibhabha wanted a single but Taylor sends him back. Some nerves for the visitors' skipper.
Top quality delivery! Lands it full and around off, gets it to nip away. Chamu initially looked to play at it but then later, seeing the movement away, let it be.
And the innings is underway with a single. Full and on middle, flicked to square leg for a single. Taylor is up and running with that.
Starts off with one in the channel outside off, Brendan lets it be. Slight shape away there.
We are all set to begin! The Pakistan players stride out to the middle, followed by Chamu Chibhabha and Brendan Taylor. Mohammad Hasnain will start with the ball. Here we go...
For Zimbabwe, the players missing out are Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Tendai Chisoro and Richard Ngarava. Those coming in are Craig Ervine, Milton Shumba, Faraz Akram and Wellington Masakadza.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Brendan Taylor (WK), Chamu Chibhabha (C), Craig Ervine, Milton Shumba, Wesley Madhevere, Ryan Burl, Elton Chigumbura, Donald Tiripano, Faraz Akram, Blessing Muzarabani, Wellington Masakadza.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Haider Ali, Abdullah Shafique (IN PLACE OF MOHAMMED HAFEEZ), Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Imad Wasim (IN PLACE OF WAHAB RIAZ), Usman Qadir, Muhammad Musa (IN PLACE OF FAHEEM ASHRAF), Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain.
Toss - The two captains are out in the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in Zimbabwe's favour. THEY WILL BAT FIRST!

Hello and welcome one and all to the third and final T20I of this 3-game T20I series between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. There is not much to play in regard to the series as Pakistan have comfortably wrapped up the series 2-0 but both the teams will still want to go out there and put in a good performance. Pakistan will want to win the final T20I of the series and would look to whitewash Zimbabwe, while the team from Africa would look to avoid the blushes of a whitewash and will want to trump the hosts. Stay tuned as we bring you the toss and all the team updates...
